column1: # The frozen labelled claim set (R8.7, R8.8, R8.9). Written and
# fingerprinted before the detector first ran on it, and left unmodified
# thereafter: a per-class score measured against claims written after the
# detector saw them is not a measurement.
# 104 claims, each carrying exactly one of the four class labels
# (degenerate, contradicting, unsupported, consistent); 44 of them are
# labelled false — one of the three falsehood classes, not consistent —
# and every false one is copied verbatim from a recorded Oracle answer in
# the transcript named in its source column. The consistent claims are not
# copied from a transcript: R8.7 freezes only the false ones to a recorded
# Six tab-separated columns, one claim per row, read by phisor::truth::set:
#   about    the word the claim is about
#   kind     the relation the claim offers
#   other    the other word the relation names (empty is a degenerate field)
#   weight   the claim's weight on the 0..=1 scale
#   label    one of degenerate contradicting unsupported consistent
#   source   the transcript the false claim was taken from, or - when the
#            claim is consistent and written for the set
# --- contradicting (16): a declared Law of the kind is broken by a held row
# --- degenerate (16): a self-edge, or a field empty after trimming
# --- unsupported (12): readable, no Law to break, nothing held supports it
# --- consistent (60): written for the set, about words the World holds no
# --- Law against, so the detector reads each as unsupported (it returns no
# --- Consistent from the classifier core) and the finding is reported, not
